scope: Last seven UTC days of grid; both joins see the complete weather history. Three warm repeated runs after EXPLAIN ANALYZE. Separate database connections per alternative; peak buffer memory is connection high-water mark including its EXPLAIN, not incremental allocation.

results.name: before
results.query:
-- Baseline: inequality join materializes all eligible preceding reports, then ranks.
select airport,cutoff,observed_at,visibility from (
  select h.airport,h.cutoff,w.observed_at,w.visibility,
    row_number() over(partition by h.airport,h.cutoff order by w.available_at desc) as rn
  from (SELECT * FROM int_airport_hours WHERE cutoff >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 23:00:00' - INTERVAL '7 days') h left join weather w
  on h.airport=w.airport and h.cutoff>=w.available_at
) where rn=1 order by airport,cutoff;

results.name: after
results.query:
-- Optimized: ASOF operator selects exactly one preceding report without the fan-out.
select h.airport,h.cutoff,w.observed_at,w.visibility
from (SELECT * FROM int_airport_hours WHERE cutoff >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 23:00:00' - INTERVAL '7 days') h asof left join weather w
on h.airport=w.airport and h.cutoff>=w.available_at
order by h.airport,h.cutoff;
